summary: CMS full-stack TypeScript dựa trên Astro, cung cấp nền tảng quản lý nội dung hiện đại và nhẹ như kế tinh thần của WordPress.
usecases: Deploy content websites and blogs with easy management and high performance.
Develop enterprise websites requiring SEO optimization and fast loading speeds.
Allow teams to customize themes and plugins for the Astro-based CMS.
ideas: Integrate AI agent to automatically generate and manage website content.
Use as a foundation for event registration and ticketing systems with built-in user management.
Develop multilingual CMS capabilities with cross-platform content export.
